Playlists for RetroArch

Dogmatix+ writes one playlist per console into RetroArch\'s playlists folder, named the way RetroArch names its own (Nintendo - Game Boy Advance.lpl), listing the games on this device. RetroArch then shows them in its main menu without a scan. A playlist you already have is only added to: its entries, their cores and their order stay as they are, and games it already lists are not added again. Before it changes, its current version is kept in %1$s.

Usually RetroArch/playlists on internal storage; RetroArch shows its own under Settings → Directory → Playlists. Android does not let other apps pick a folder inside Android/data: if RetroArch\'s is there, first set RetroArch\'s Playlists directory to a folder you can pick.
